purpose: Candidate dataset example videos for the CARDPol project page. Local clips were copied without re-encoding. EgoDex originals were extracted from the official archive and copies were encoded as H.264 for web playback. No website has been created.
notes: The dmc clips are older 96x96 previews; verify the desired color/background settings against the paper before presenting them as exact experimental inputs.
Clean and video LIBERO previews are provided as pairs; only the three suites evaluated in the paper are included.
OGBench clips already include the side-by-side distraction; the source files are not clean clips.
These clips illustrate data, not comparative method performance.
EgoDex dataset license: CC BY-NC-ND, per its official repository. Attribution and unchanged original files are included; the web copies only change encoding.
